message.content:
탐색 목표: MallCodeMapping을 동적으로 구현하기 위한 기존 패턴 파악

1. proxy API 관련 코드 탐색:
   - outbound/client/proxy-api/ 구조와 ProxyApiClient 패턴
   - 몰(mall) 정보를 조회하는 기존 API나 GraphQL 쿼리가 있는지 확인

2. Valkey/캐시 패턴 탐색:
   - outbound/repository/cache/ 구조
   - 기존 캐시 사용 패턴 (ValkeyCacheRepository 등)
   - 캐시 갱신/조회 패턴

3. 도메인 모델 확인:
   - Mall 관련 도메인 모델이 있는지 (domain/proxy 등)
   - mallId, shopCode 관련 필드가 어디서 사용되는지

결과물: 파일 경로와 핵심 코드 패턴을 정리해서 반환

1→package com.cowave.search.outbound_adapter.proxy

     4→import com.cowave.search.domain.proxy.mall.Mall

     6→import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
     7→import kotlin.jvm.java
     8→import kotlin.text.trimIndent
     9→import kotlin.to
    10→
    11→@Component
    12→class MallRepositoryImpl(
    13→    private val client: ProxyApiClient,
    14→) : MallRepository {
    15→    override fun findAllByIds(mallIds: List<Int>): List<Mall> {
    16→        val query =
    17→            """
    18→            query GetMalls(${'$'}ids: [Int!]) {
    19→                malls(input: {  ids: ${'$'}ids }) {
    20→                    items {
    21→                        mallId
    22→                        mallUseYnDanawa
    23→                        mallUseYnEnuri
    24→                    }
    25→                }
    26→            }
    27→            """.trimIndent()
    28→
    29→        return client.query(
    30→            query = query,
    31→            variables = mapOf("ids" to mallIds),
    32→            retrievePath = "malls.items",
    33→            Mall::class.java,
    34→        )
    35→    }
    36→}

1→package com.cowave.search.repository.cache.config
     2→
     3→import com.cowave.search.repository.cache.dto.AttributeBoostData
     4→import com.cowave.search.repository.cache.dto.CategoryBoostData
     5→import com.cowave.shared.utils.logger
     6→import org.springframework.data.redis.core.RedisTemplate
     7→import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
     8→
     9→@Component
    10→class ValkeyBoostStore(
    11→    private val redisTemplate: RedisTemplate<String, String>,
    12→) {
    13→    companion object {
    14→        private val log by logger()
    15→        private const val CATEGORY_BOOST_KEY = "BOOSTKEYWORD:BOOST"
    16→        private const val ATTRIBUTE_BOOST_KEY = "ATTRIBUTEVALUESEQ_BOOSTKEYWORD:BOOST"
    17→    }
    18→
    19→    fun getCategoryBoosts(keyword: String): List<CategoryBoostData>? =
    20→        getBoostValue(keyword, CATEGORY_BOOST_KEY)?.let { value ->
    21→            parseCategoryBoosts(value)
    22→        }
    23→
    24→    fun getAttributeBoosts(keyword: String): List<AttributeBoostData>? =
    25→        getBoostValue(keyword, ATTRIBUTE_BOOST_KEY)?.let { value ->
    26→            parseAttributeBoosts(value)
    27→        }
    28→
    29→    private fun getBoostValue(
    30→        keyword: String,
    31→        cacheKey: String,
    32→    ): String? =
    33→        runCatching {
    34→            redisTemplate
    35→                .opsForHash<String, String>()
    36→                .get(cacheKey, keyword)
    37→                ?.also { log.debug("Cache HIT [$cacheKey]: '$keyword'") }
    38→                ?: run {
    39→                    log.debug("Cache MISS [$cacheKey]: '$keyword'")
    40→                    null
    41→                }
    42→        }.onFailure { e ->
    43→            log.error("Cache ERROR [$cacheKey]: '$keyword'", e)
    44→        }.getOrNull()
    45→
    46→    private fun parseCategoryBoosts(value: String): List<CategoryBoostData> {
    47→        if (value.isBlank()) return emptyList()
    48→
    49→        return value.split(",").mapNotNull { item ->
    50→            val parts = item.split("|")
    51→            if (parts.size == 3) {
    52→                CategoryBoostData(
    53→                    code = parts[0],
    54→                    depth = parts[1],
    55→                    score = parts[2].toIntOrNull() ?: 0,
    56→                )
    57→            } else {
    58→                log.warn("Invalid CategoryBoost format: '$item'")
    59→                null
    60→            }
    61→        }
    62→    }
    63→
    64→    private fun parseAttributeBoosts(value: String): List<AttributeBoostData> {
    65→        if (value.isBlank()) return emptyList()
    66→
    67→        return value.split(",").mapNotNull { group ->
    68→            val parts = group.split("|")
    69→            if (parts.size >= 2) {
    70→                AttributeBoostData(
    71→                    attributeValueSeqs = parts.dropLast(1),
    72→                    weight = parts.last().toIntOrNull() ?: 0,
    73→                )
    74→            } else {
    75→                log.warn("Invalid AttributeBoost format: '$group'")
    76→                null
    77→            }
    78→        }
    79→    }
    80→}

    22→     */
    23→    fun toGroupedRequests(changedDataList: List<ChangedData<ChangedProductDocument>>): List<GroupedLegacySyncRequest> {
    24→        return changedDataList
    25→            .mapNotNull { changedData -> toSingleRequest(changedData) }
    26→            .groupBy { it.operation to it.serviceType }
    27→            .map { (key, requests) ->
    28→                GroupedLegacySyncRequest(
    29→                    serviceType = key.second,
    30→                    operation = key.first,
    31→                    payloads = requests.map { it.payload },
    32→                )
    33→            }

    36→    private fun toSingleRequest(changedData: ChangedData<ChangedProductDocument>): LegacySyncRequest? {
    37→        val document = changedData.afterData ?: changedData.beforeData ?: return null

    39→
    40→        val serviceType = if (document.isCatalogMatch) LegacyServiceType.PDM else LegacyServiceType.TCMPNY_LINK

    42→        val payload =

    44→                toLinkProductRequest(document, shopCode)
    45→            } else {
    46→                toUnlinkProductRequest(document, shopCode)
    47→            }
    48→
